faq.q: Who can do video, social media, website and SEO in one place?
faq.a: In-house marketers, groups of freelancers, full-service agencies and productised monthly plans can all cover these. For small UK businesses, a productised plan such as ContentFellow's Growth Fellow at £389 a month is usually the most affordable way to get all four under one strategy.

faq.q: How much does an all-in-one marketing agency cost in the UK?
faq.a: Full-service agency retainers typically cost £3,500 to £16,750 a month in 2026. Productised all-in-one plans can cost a fraction of that, with fixed monthly deliverables.

faq.q: Is it cheaper to hire a marketing executive or outsource?
faq.a: For most small businesses, outsourcing is cheaper. A UK marketing executive earns £29,000 to £34,000 on average before employer National Insurance, pension, tools and recruitment, and one person rarely covers every skill.

faq.q: Is it better to use one provider or several specialists?
faq.a: One provider makes it easier to keep a single strategy, one report and one point of contact. Several specialists can work well if you have the time to coordinate them.

faq.q: What should an all-in-one marketing package include?
faq.a: At minimum: regular photo and video content, social media posting, a website that's kept updated and secure, SEO, and one report that shows how it all performs together.

faq.q: Can I start with one service and add the others later?
faq.a: Yes, with most monthly providers. At ContentFellow you can start with one Fellow and add, remove or upgrade from the next month.
